title: Greek Chicken Pitas
shortDescription: Lemon-oregano chicken with cucumber, tomato, and tzatziki in pita
subtitle: Lemon-oregano chicken with cucumber, tomato, and tzatziki in pita
description: Chicken is marinated in yogurt, lemon, and oregano, grilled, and tucked into warm pita with cucumber, tomato, red onion, and tzatziki. Open-faced on the line so chicken, pita, and tzatziki are visible before folding.

steps.title: Marinate chicken
steps.instruction: Combine yogurt, lemon juice, oregano, garlic, salt, and pepper. Coat chicken and refrigerate at least 2 hours. Remove 30 minutes before grilling if time allows.

steps.title: Grill chicken
steps.instruction: Grill over medium-high until 160°F, 5–7 minutes per side. Rest 5 minutes and slice into strips. Chicken should taste lemon-herb bright, not warm-spice shawarma.

steps.title: Prep vegetables and warm pita
steps.instruction: Dice cucumber and tomato; salt lightly and drain on paper towels. Warm pita wrapped in foil in a 300°F oven 8 minutes. Target oven/smoker temperature: 300°F.

steps.title: Fill pitas for the line
steps.instruction: Spread tzatziki inside each pita. Add chicken, cucumber, tomato, and onion. Crumble feta if using. Leave pitas open on trays so the crew sees Greek build before folding.

steps.title: Fold and hold
steps.instruction: Fold pitas and wrap in foil. Hold at 200°F up to 20 minutes. Suggested sides: Greek salad or lemon potatoes if you have oven space.

proTips: English cucumber has fewer seeds and keeps pitas from going soggy.
If pita tears, serve as a chicken-tzatziki plate with pita on the side.
Do not swap in shawarma marinade — crews should taste the difference from shawarma pitas on the same menu cycle.
tonightSpread: Greek pitas with simple orzo or rice
leftovers: Chicken on a salad with remaining tzatziki
whyCrewsLikeIt: Lighter than a burger run but still filling. Greek bowls exist in the catalog; pitas are the handheld version crews can eat walking to the rig. Feta at the line is optional but popular.
mealPrepNotes: Marinate chicken at least 2 hours or overnight. Make tzatziki the day before. Warm pita in foil packets. Assemble open on sheet pans for speed, then fold for eating.
